summary: This 8-K reports routine operational and disclosure items for Carlyle Credit Solutions, Inc., a business development company. The company issued 920,180 Class I shares at $18.04 NAV for $16.6 million in a continuous private offering under Regulation D/S, declared a $0.14/share dividend, and disclosed monthly NAV. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring is present; it is a standard periodic filing for a BDC.
